import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
VDW={"C":1.70,"N":1.55,"O":1.52,"S":1.80,"P":1.80,"SE":1.90}
MAXASA={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLU':223,'GLN':225,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,
        'ILE':197,'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,
        'TYR':263,'VAL':174,'MSE':224}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLU':'E','GLN':'Q','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(lines):
    atoms=[]
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if line.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            resn=line[17:20].strip()
            if line.startswith("HETATM") and resn!="MSE": continue
            el=(line[76:78].strip() or line[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            if el in ("H","D"): continue
            atoms.append(dict(resn=resn,chain=line[21],resi=int(line[22:26]),name=line[12:16].strip(),
                              x=float(line[30:38]),y=float(line[38:46]),z=float(line[46:54]),el=el,b=float(line[60:66])))
    return atoms
def _sph(n=400):
    i=np.arange(n,dtype=float)+0.5; phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    return np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
SP=_sph(400)
def sasa(atoms,probe=1.4):
    xyz=np.array([[a["x"],a["y"],a["z"]] for a in atoms]);rad=np.array([VDW.get(a["el"],1.7) for a in atoms])+probe
    n=len(atoms);out=np.zeros(n);cell=rad.max()*2
    idx=np.floor(xyz/cell).astype(int);keys={}
    for i,k in enumerate(map(tuple,idx)): keys.setdefault(k,[]).append(i)
    for i in range(n):
        k=tuple(idx[i]);nb=[]
        for dx in(-1,0,1):
            for dy in(-1,0,1):
                for dz in(-1,0,1): nb+=keys.get((k[0]+dx,k[1]+dy,k[2]+dz),[])
        nb=np.array([j for j in nb if j!=i]); pts=xyz[i]+SP*rad[i]
        acc=np.ones(len(pts),bool) if len(nb)==0 else (((pts[:,None,:]-xyz[nb][None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)>=(rad[nb]**2)[None,:]).all(1)
        out[i]=4*np.pi*rad[i]**2*acc.mean()
    return out
def byres(atoms,ar):
    d={}
    for a,s in zip(atoms,ar): d[(a["chain"],a["resi"],a["resn"])]=d.get((a["chain"],a["resi"],a["resn"]),0)+s
    return d
rcsb=lambda p: requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=180).text.splitlines()

at=parse(rcsb("6YTU")); A=[a for a in at if a["chain"]=="A"]; B=[a for a in at if a["chain"]=="B"]
sA=byres(A,sasa(A)); sB=byres(B,sasa(B)); sAB=byres(at,sasa(at))
rows=[]
for (c,i,rn) in sorted(set(list(sA)+list(sB))):
    free=(sA if c=="A" else sB)[(c,i,rn)]; bnd=sAB[(c,i,rn)]
    rows.append(dict(chain=c,resi=i,resn=rn,aa=AA3[rn],SASA_monomer=free,SASA_dimer=bnd,BSA=free-bnd,
                     frac_buried=(free-bnd)/free if free>0 else 0))
d6=pd.DataFrame(rows)
coil=d6.groupby("resi").agg(aa=("aa","first"),BSA=("BSA","mean"),frac=("frac_buried","mean")).reset_index()
iface=d6.BSA.sum()/2

afat=parse(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q7LC44-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=150).text.splitlines())
rec={}
for a,s in zip(afat,sasa(afat)):
    d=rec.setdefault(a["resi"],dict(resn=a["resn"],S=0.0,p=a["b"])); d["S"]+=s
af=pd.DataFrame([dict(resi=i,aa=AA3[v["resn"]],SASA=v["S"],rel=v["S"]/MAXASA.get(v["resn"],200),pLDDT=v["p"]) for i,v in sorted(rec.items())])

gs=parse(rcsb("6GSE")); sg=byres(gs,sasa(gs))
dg=pd.DataFrame([dict(resi=i,aa=AA3[rn],SASA=v,rel=v/MAXASA.get(rn,200)) for (c,i,rn),v in sorted(sg.items())])

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,10.5))
G=fig.add_gridspec(4,2,height_ratios=[1.05,1,1,1.05],hspace=0.75,wspace=0.26)

axA=fig.add_subplot(G[0,:]); axA.set_xlim(-10,405); axA.set_ylim(-0.6,4.4); axA.axis("off")
axA.text(198,4.25,"A   Human Arc (Q7LC44, 396 aa): domains and reported determinants",ha="center",fontsize=11,weight="bold")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((1,1.1),395,0.5,fc="#e2e8f0",ec="k",lw=0.6))
for nm,a,b,c in [("Arc MA domain\nPF19284",46,154,"#f6ad55"),("Arc N-lobe\nPF21395",214,275,"#63b3ed"),
                 ("Arc C-lobe\nPF18162",278,359,"#68d391")]:
    axA.add_patch(Rectangle((a,1.0),b-a,0.7,fc=c,ec="k",lw=0.6))
    axA.text((a+b)/2,1.35,nm,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7)
    axA.text((a+b)/2,0.55,f"{a}-{b}",ha="center",fontsize=6.5,color="#4a5568")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((89,2.1),11,0.3,fc="#e53e3e",ec="k",lw=0.5))
axA.text(94,2.55,"endophilin SH3GL1/3\n89-100 (PMID 17088211)",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#c53030")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((99,3.25),33,0.3,fc="#dd6b20",ec="k",lw=0.5))
axA.text(118,3.70,"NT oligomerisation coil 99-132 (PDB 6YTU)",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#c05621")
axA.add_patch(Rectangle((195,2.1),19,0.3,fc="#805ad5",ec="k",lw=0.5))
axA.text(205,2.55,"dynamin DNM2\n195-214 (PMID 17088211)",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#553c9a")
for s_,lab in [(260,"S260"),(278,"T278")]:
    axA.plot([s_,s_],[0.95,1.75],color="k",lw=1.3)
    axA.text(s_,-0.05,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7)
axA.text(269,-0.45,"CaMKII sites (PMID 31151856)",ha="center",fontsize=6.8)

axB=fig.add_subplot(G[1,:])
axB.bar(coil.resi,coil.BSA,color=["#e53e3e" if i<=100 else "#dd6b20" for i in coil.resi],width=0.78)
axB.set_xlim(97.5,133); axB.set_ylabel("buried SASA ($\\AA^2$)")
axB.set_title("B   Only experimental Arc self-association interface: NT coil dimer (PDB 6YTU, 0.95 $\\AA$), %.0f $\\AA^2$ buried per subunit"%iface,
              fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
for _,r in coil.iterrows():
    if r.BSA>55: axB.text(r.resi,r.BSA+3,f"{r.aa}{int(r.resi)}",ha="center",fontsize=6.5)
axB.axvline(100.5,color="k",ls="--",lw=0.9)
axB.text(99.4,112,"endophilin region 89-100 ends here",fontsize=6.5,color="#c53030",ha="left")
axB.set_ylim(0,125)

axC=fig.add_subplot(G[2,:])
axC.plot(af.resi,af.pLDDT,lw=1.0,color="#2b6cb0"); axC.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
axC.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); axC.set_xlabel("residue"); axC.set_xlim(1,396); axC.set_ylim(0,100)
for a,b,c in [(46,154,"#f6ad55"),(214,275,"#63b3ed"),(278,359,"#68d391")]: axC.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.17)
for a,b,c in [(89,100,"#e53e3e"),(195,214,"#805ad5")]: axC.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.35)
axC.set_title("C   AlphaFold v6: the DNM2 determinant 195-214 lies in a disordered linker (mean pLDDT 37.0, all residues < 70)",
              fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

axD=fig.add_subplot(G[3,0])
items=[("Q99",coil[coil.resi==99].frac.iloc[0]),("E100",coil[coil.resi==100].frac.iloc[0]),
       ("M113/W116/F120\ncoil core",coil[coil.resi.isin([113,116,120])].frac.mean())]
axD.bar([i[0] for i in items],[i[1] for i in items],color=["#e53e3e","#e53e3e","#dd6b20"])
axD.set_ylabel("fraction of residue SASA\nburied by self-association"); axD.set_ylim(0,1)
axD.set_title("D   Burial at the NT coil interface",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
for i,(n,v) in enumerate(items): axD.text(i,v+0.02,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axD.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)

axE=fig.add_subplot(G[3,1])
sel=[212,213,214,241,257,260,277,278,335]
sub=dg[dg.resi.isin(sel)]
cols=["#805ad5" if r.resi<215 else ("#1a202c" if r.resi in (260,278) else "#718096") for _,r in sub.iterrows()]
axE.bar([f"{r.aa}{r.resi}" for _,r in sub.iterrows()],sub.rel,color=cols)
axE.set_ylabel("relative SASA, isolated\ncapsid domain (PDB 6GSE)"); axE.set_ylim(0,0.9)
axE.set_title("E   Capsid domain surface: DNM2 tail (purple) and\n      CaMKII/oligomerisation residues",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
axE.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=7.5,rotation=45)
plt.show()

out=os.getcwd()
d6.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"arc_6YTU_interface_bsa.csv"),index=False)
af.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"arc_alphafold_Q7LC44_sasa_plddt.csv"),index=False)
dg.to_csv(os.path.join(out,"arc_6GSE_capsid_domain_sasa.csv"),index=False)
print("interface per subunit %.0f A2 | Q99 %.2f | E100 %.2f"%(iface,coil[coil.resi==99].frac.iloc[0],coil[coil.resi==100].frac.iloc[0]))
